# #2788: Patch: cargo jackioh fx census: what each card's plays and hooks do on the board, from recorded games
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

The set passes of #2782 give each of the 634 cards an animation motif. `docs/issues-and-patches.md` ("A task over every card") says such a pass groups cards by what they do, never by comparing card texts. This part builds that grouping as a tool: **`cargo jackioh fx census`**. It plays seeded games and reports, for every card and every hook, what lands on the board, plus a suggested motif.

### Shape (a suggestion; read `crates/tools/README.md` and the `fuzz` command first)

- **Games.** Play N seeded games the way `fuzz` does: random policy, every shipped set, with handicap and duos off.
  - Use `--seeds` (default `FX_CENSUS_SEEDS`, a named constant in `crates/tools`).
  - Force each card into enough games to be seen: a seeded deck that carries it, so every card is played at least `FX_CENSUS_MIN_SEEN` times.
- **Windows.** For each card and hook, read the event stream:
  - a play's window runs from `cardPlayed` to `cardResolved` or `countered`;
  - a hook's window runs from #2783's `hookResolving` marker to the next marker or `cardResolved`.
- **What it records per card and hook:**
  - the event types and their counts;
  - the number of targets;
  - the sides touched (own, enemy, both);
  - the lanes touched (one, adjacent, all);
  - whether any damage was split at random;
  - whether a unit came back from the graveyard;
  - whether your own units were destroyed as a cost;
  - the `via` keywords seen.
- **The suggested motif.** Map the most common event family to a motif through the "Events" column of the motif table in `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`. Keep that mapping in one place in the tool, cited to the doc. A card whose windows show nothing is suggested `"none: vanilla"`, or `"none: unseen"` if it was never played.
- **Output.**
  - `--format md` writes a table with one row per card, grouped by set, for the set passes' pull requests.
  - `--format json` writes a file a test can read.
  - It writes to stdout or `--out`. It commits nothing.
- **Purity.** It lives in `crates/tools`, which may use the disk and a clock. The pure crates are untouched (CLAUDE.md rule 4).
- **Docs.** Document the command in `crates/tools/README.md`. No workflow runs it, so no CLAUDE.md rule 13 entry is needed.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `cargo jackioh fx census --seeds <n> --format md|json` runs over every shipped set and reports each non-token card, plus tokens seen, with every field above.
- [ ] Every non-token card is seen at least `FX_CENSUS_MIN_SEEN` times, or is listed as unseen with the reason (tested on a small catalog fixture).
- [ ] The suggested motif follows the doc's table. Unit tests with fixture event streams cover one card per motif family, a random split (`barrage`), a one-lane hit (`lance`), a graveyard return (`rise`) and an own-unit cost (`offering`).
- [ ] The same seeds give the same output (deterministic, tested).
- [ ] `crates/tools/README.md` documents it.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace …` pass.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2783. Part of #2782.
